note: Five builders rewrote lighting, materials, geometry, cut faces and juice; five independent critics blind-scored the real frames against the plate with pixel measurements. Net result: only juice improved. Overall composition got WORSE, because stage.js added a warm blade-flare streak whose broad haze lobe floods the entire frame — corner luminance 178 against the plate's 5. That is a good outcome for the loop: the critics caught a regression the builder was proud of, with numbers. Deep diagnoses landed on every piece and all of them port to TSL even though the GLSL does not. Harness was hardened before this ran: render at 0.5 scale, every await bounded, hard watchdog. Full run, zero errors, slowest beat 5.4s.

pieces.name: Lighting & grade
pieces.biggestGap: The blade flare's broad haze lobe plus bloom floods the frame with a milky peach wash, destroying the pure-black void that is the plate's defining grade property.
pieces.fix: Delete the haze term; shrink the streak to ~1.0 units tall so it cannot reach the corners.

pieces.name: Fruit materials
pieces.biggestGap: Pith, membranes, core and seed collar are rendered at nearly the same dark olive value as the flesh, so every cut face collapses into one mottled disc with no flesh→pith→rind layering.
pieces.fix: Push all pale anatomy to genuinely pale values and widen the bands so they survive at half resolution.

pieces.name: Fruit silhouette
pieces.biggestGap: No fruit is identifiable by outline — measured watermelon bbox is 99x101px, a mathematically perfect circle, at 28% of frame height against the plate's 55%.
pieces.fix: Stop treating silhouette as a perturbation of a sphere; add real appendage geometry (pineapple crown, strawberry calyx, apple stem well) and raise fruit scale in frame.

pieces.name: Cut faces & rind
pieces.biggestGap: The cut edge has no geometric rind: peel/pith/flesh is a 1-2px painted stroke on a flat disc whose boundary shows straight polygon chords, so each half reads as a ball with a lid decal.
pieces.fix: Resample the clip ring to kill visible chords and build the rind as real geometry rather than shader bands.

pieces.name: Juice fluid
pieces.biggestGap: The sheet's life curve is inverted — invisible at the cut, peaking at 250ms as a rigid opaque radially-symmetric starburst, and it never tears into fingers, strings or beads.
pieces.fix: Invert the time envelope: full extent by 30-40ms, gone by ~130ms, dying by tearing rather than by fading.
